parts.name: Opener
parts.Basic_description: The opener is the front panel of the trashcan, typically made of durable plastic. It includes a handle for easy access.
parts.Functional_description: It allows users to open and close the trashcan to dispose of waste. It acts as the main interface for user interaction.
parts.Movement_description: It can pivot or swing open when pulled by the handle, and return to a closed position when released.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main container structure of the trashcan, made of rigid plastic to hold waste securely.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the main storage volume for trash and supports the opener. It ensures stability and containment of waste.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during normal operation, serving as the fixed support for the opener.
